We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineering leader to join the Veeva Platform Center of Efficiency asAssociate Director, Veeva Platform Engineering Lead. Reporting to the Director, Center of Efficiency, this role leads engineering execution across the enterprise Veeva Platform ecosystem, with India as the primary location and Prague, Budapest, and Barcelona also considered.

The successful candidate will work across multiple Veeva Vault domains, driving consistency, reuse, engineering standards, and platform\-wide best practices that maximize business value across the broader Veeva ecosystem.
  
The ideal candidate combines deep Veeva expertise, strong integration and engineering leadership, platform thinking, and hands\-on technical capability. * Secondary skill: Stakeholder management, Veeva Vault Certification

* Deep expertise on architecture, implementation, platform activities functional knowledge on multiple Veeva Vault domains such as Quality, Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, Medical, or related Veeva applications, with demonstrated ability to operate beyond individual Vault boundaries in a multi\-Vault platform ecosystem.
* Strong experience delivering enterprise integrations using Veeva APIs, MuleSoft, event\-driven architectures, API\-led connectivity, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience implementing secure integration and authentication patterns, including OAuth, authentication modernization, and enterprise security best practices.
* Experience working in GxP\-regulated environments with an understanding of compliance, validation, quality, and operational risk requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business leaders across multiple organizations.
* Experience managing Agile delivery processes, engineering backlogs, prioritization, demand management, and roadmap\-aligned execution.

* Experience across multiple Veeva Vault domains rollout strategy

* Experience leading platform modernization, transformation, or engineering excellence initiatives.
* Knowledge of AI\-assisted software engineering, GenAI technologies, and emerging AI delivery practices.
* Experience with ITIL disciplines including Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and enterprise architecture principles.
* Experience building and scaling engineering teams within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience within the pharmaceutical or life sciences domain.
* Any vault\-specific Veeva certification (Clinical, RIM, QMS, Safety, Medical).
* Experience with Veeva Vault Java SDK.
